answer_1.quote: We prompt LLMs with personas to rewrite benchmark test examples in each persona's writing style while preserving the original meaning.
answer_1.outputs: persona‑augmented rephrased prompts and generated code snippets

answer_2.quote: We report results based on both recall (i.e., token‑level overlap of the answer with correct gold labels) and cosine similarity (considering the semantics between the answer and correct gold labels). For CosmosQA and DS-1000 we estimate accuracy.

answer_3.quote: We employ an LLM directly in our pipeline to determine whether the rephrased context entails all the ground‑truth answers to the associated questions.
